crew.overview: A novelist fed up with the establishment profiting from "Black" entertainment uses a pen name to write a book that propels him into the heart of hypocrisy and the madness he claims to disdain.
crew.title: American Fiction

details.biography: Cristina Dunlap has worked as a Director of Photography on numerous award-winning projects including feature films, television series, music videos and commercials. She just finished principal photography for the upcoming feature F**K directed by Cord Jefferson. Her recent credits include Cooper Raiff's Cha Cha Real Smooth, which won the Sundance Audience Award and is currently streaming on Apple TV+, as well as Am I Ok?, the directorial debut of Tig Notaro and Stephanie Allynne, starring Dakota Johnson and Sonoya Mizuno.
details.name: Cristina Dunlap
